title: Buying a Phonak Hearing Aid? Be SMART About ₹50,000 vs ₹1,00,000

nodes.name: 01-hook
must_show: nothing extra on the board — the bonus tease is spoken, not shown
talk: Deliver the frozen Hindi hook verbatim (02-hook.md)
Point at the Bluetooth cell on 'woh unke 50,000 wale device mein hai hi nahi'
The frozen hook now ends with the bonus tease: 'aur ek chhota sa tool, jo 6 sawaal mein aapko aapka jawab de dega'
nodes.blocked: Bonus tease is inside the hook — Knowledge Hub page + gate must be live before this is recorded

nodes.name: 01b-trust
talk: Namaskaar, mera naam hai Chintan Bhayani, Founder of Synva Hearing
Pichle 2 saal mein 1000+ logon ko hearing loss, lifestyle aur budget ke hisaab se sahi hearing aid lene mein madad ki hai
CHECK: earlier scripts say 500+ over the same 2-year window — confirm the number before recording

nodes.name: 02-chapters
talk: Teen cheezein, phir end mein tool
Bonus already teased in the hook — do not repeat it here, just reference it

nodes.name: 03-same-ear
must_show: fitting range 0-110 dB moderate to profound
prominent filled band, not a footnote
talk: Not one rupee of the extra ₹40,000 buys more hearing
Same fitting range, same warranty. So what IS different?

nodes.name: 04-framework
talk: This video is Steps 2 and 3 colliding
Budget is the last filter, never the first

nodes.name: 04b-mrp-note
must_show: what you pay is lower, varies by clinic
ask us as well — the Synva nudge, an invitation to compare, never a claim to be cheapest
talk: Har price jo aap dekhoge, woh MRP hai
Aap jo actually doge woh kam hoga, aur har clinic alag discount deta hai
Apne clinic se poocho. Aur humse bhi pooch lo, hum bata denge exactly kitna padega
Say it once here. Do NOT repeat it on every price board.

nodes.name: 05-band-50k
must_show: Terra / Orion C&G 50 / Sirion Connect 75 at ~₹46,200-₹49,500 pair
Synva's assessment in its own bordered panel (rule 6d)
talk: Same money, three devices
Terra: 8 channels, no Bluetooth, no rechargeable
Orion 50: rechargeable, and what actually sells most here
Sirion 75: 12 channels and Bluetooth, but batteries
Terra and Orion perform similarly; Sirion a little better

nodes.name: 06-the-turn
must_show: ₹50,000 pe Phonak aapko dono mein se ek bhi nahi deta
talk: Rechargeable chahiye? Phonak nahi de sakta iss price pe
Bluetooth chahiye? Woh bhi nahi
Isiliye ₹50,000 pe hum honestly Signia recommend karte hai
Say it once. Do not linger, do not compare further.

nodes.name: 07-band-1lakh
must_show: all 7, grouped by platform: Lumity block then Infinio block
COMMON band stated once: 12 channels, Universal Bluetooth, 2 year warranty
NOT in the common band: fitting range — Naida L30-PR is 90 dB and both Virtos are null
Audeo I30-R Go anchored as BEST SELLER
Naida L30-SP EXCLUDED, rarely stocked in India
talk: At this price the choice becomes the body, not performance
Audeo I30-R Go is the one that sells most — same aid as the I30-R, pocket charger instead of the desk one
L30 is the Lumity fallback if budget is tight
Virto for custom, Naida for power

nodes.name: 08-what-40k-buys
talk: Terra -> Terra+ is MARGINAL: Bluetooth, 2 channels, SoundRecover2
Terra+ -> ₹1,00,000 is MEANINGFUL: on Terra+ the AutoSense is limited and I can barely tune the environmental programs in the fitting software
Roger is the meetings feature and does not exist below this tier

nodes.name: 09-do-cheezein
must_show: Panel 1: Mujhe behind-the-ear chahiye -> no BTE on Infinio at all; profound + rechargeable does not exist
Panel 2: Mujhe invisible chahiye aur rechargeable bhi -> rechargeable custom stops at ITC
talk: Do cheezein jo Phonak aaj kisi bhi price pe nahi de sakta
NEVER say 'Phonak has no rechargeable BTE' — Naida L30-PR exists
Signia has both. One sentence, then move on.

nodes.name: 10-bonus-tool
must_show: the six questions as short lines
URL as its own editable text node
what they get back: their band + their models
talk: Shuru mein bola tha, yeh raha
6 sawaal, band bhi milega aur models bhi
Link description mein, sabse upar
nodes.blocked: Knowledge Hub page + gate must be live before recording

nodes.name: 11-dont-buy
talk: Yeh model hum bechte hai, par logo ko lene se rokte hai
Terra platform pe rechargeable ke liye itna pay karna galat hai
Thoda aur do, aur poora platform badal jata hai

nodes.name: 12-lifestyle-map
must_show: each mapped to a band and a named model
talk: L1: ₹50,000 is MORE than enough. Orion.
L2: ₹50,000 is a very good start; ₹1,00,000 if you want more than enough
L3: ₹1,00,000 is a sensible investment; ₹50,000 will not carry you through meetings
The honest don't-overspend beat lands here

nodes.name: 13-cta
must_show: synva.io as its own text node
talk: Confusion is normal
Our audiologists run this same framework on your audiogram

edges.label: closes L2: two things at any price
closes L1: the one we don't sell you
